name: seed-loader
summary: Implemented standards seed loading, app mount initialization, and admin reset-to-seed action.
completed_work: Created lib/storage/seed-loader.ts with initializeSeedData() and resetToSeedData().
Seed loader fetches four document type seed files and public/data/common-review-items.json.
initializeSeedData() is idempotent: it inserts missing seed document types and common review items without replacing existing user data.
resetToSeedData() replaces document_types, review_items, and common_review_items with seed-derived arrays while leaving other localStorage keys untouched.
Created components/seed-initializer.tsx to run initializeSeedData() once on app mount and warn on errors.
Replaced admin page initialization with initializeSeedData() and added a 기본값으로 초기화 button that calls resetToSeedData(), shows toast feedback, and reloads the page.
decisions: Seed loader writes directly to the existing draftreviewr:* localStorage keys to avoid changing lib/storage/local-storage.ts outside this step's owned paths.
The loader preserves existing data during initializeSeedData() by checking seed ids and appending only missing seed records.
The admin reset does not clear documents, review results, API keys, LLM configs, active provider, or future language settings.
The admin list components read storage on mount, so the reset action reloads the page after showing a toast.

verification.notes: Home document type dropdown showed 표준초안 plus ITU-T 표준초안, ITU-T 기고서, JTC 1 표준초안, and JTC 1 기고서. Admin page had exactly one 기본값으로 초기화 button and displayed ITU-T 표준초안 content.
Passed after step2-output and step status update.

known_issues: app/page.tsx still calls legacy initializeDefaultData(); because SeedInitializer inserts missing seed ids, this does not block Step 2, but a later cleanup step could remove the legacy call when owned.
The in-app browser evaluation environment could not read localStorage directly, so browser verification used visible document type options and admin page content as the observable signal.
next_actions: Add draftreviewr:language storage and settings UI.
Inject ko/en language instructions into legacy openai-client and all four provider prompt builders.
resume_hint: Resume with phases/4-standards-seed/step3.md. Seed files are now loaded through lib/storage/seed-loader.ts and app/layout.tsx mounts SeedInitializer.
